description: This PHP source file handles adding and editing port management rules with form validation, dynamic content initialization, and device management features in a web-based network configuration interface.

methods.name: initPmFields
methods.description: Initializes form fields with existing rule data if editing.

methods.name: initConnDevTable
methods.description: Populates connected device table dynamically with current data.

methods.name: initValidation
methods.description: Adds form validation rules for IPs and ports.

methods.name: validateIpRange
methods.description: Validates the IP address range according to subnet rules and static IP constraints.

methods.name: onsave
methods.description: Handles form submission, validates input, sends data to server via AJAX, and manages success/failure responses.

methods.name: addSelectedIp
methods.description: Adds the IP address of a selected connected device into the form fields.

methods.name: onRefreshConnectedDev
methods.description: Refreshes the list of connected devices via AJAX.
